submission.justification: Radiator-R1 at 3 cm gives the highest simulated pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c among all valid scanned candidate/thickness combinations: 4.656 sigma. This exceeds the best results for Radiator-R2 (3.92 sigma at 3 cm) and Radiator-R3 (2.809 sigma at 3 cm). All three candidates remained lifetime-valid based on the project-document review, and 3 cm is within the allowed 1–6 cm thickness range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: The maximum valid simulated separation is Radiator-R1 at 3 cm with 4.656 sigma, higher than Radiator-R2's best of 3.92 sigma and Radiator-R3's best of 2.809 sigma.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: The selected option is Radiator-R1, one of the three allowed candidates R1, R2, and R3.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime.
requirements.evidence: No explicit lifetime radiation/aging limits or disallowed operating ranges were found; zero candidates were eliminated for lifetime concerns, and selected_lifetime_valid = 1.
Selected thickness is 3 cm, within the allowed range of 1 to 6 cm.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted a single recommendation: Radiator-R1 at 3 cm.
